plan: Reduce broad index exposure (SPY) to 20% to ease concentration.
Increase income ETF (QQQI) to 20% for stability.
Exit all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) and weak individual tech names (QQQ, SMH, CRWD, METU) to cut risk.
This shifts the portfolio towards more stable income and broad market exposure.
Focus is on capital preservation with reduced volatility.
Expect lower but steadier returns.
conservative.read: This plan prioritizes capital preservation. Expect lower potential returns, around 1.5% per month, with significantly reduced drawdown risk. The focus is on stability and reducing exposure to volatile tech and leveraged products.

plan: Maintain broad index exposure (SPY) at 25%.
Increase income ETF (QQQI) to 15% for yield.
Trim profitable tech (CRWD) to 5% to reduce concentration.
Exit all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) and weak individual tech names (QQQ, SMH, METU).
This balances growth potential with risk reduction.
Aims for steady growth with controlled volatility.
balanced.read: This balanced approach targets around 2.5% monthly growth. It reduces leverage and concentration while maintaining exposure to growth sectors. Risk is managed by exiting weak positions and limiting leveraged ETFs.

plan: Reduce broad index (SPY) and income (QQQI) to make room for growth.
Increase profitable AI (CRWD) and add leveraged AI (MSFU).
Add leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to increase sector exposure.
Initiate a new position in a strong scanner setup (NVDD).
Exit all weak or underperforming positions (QQQ, SMH, METU).
This plan concentrates risk in high-conviction tech and leveraged products.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan aims for high growth, targeting ~4% monthly returns. It uses leverage and concentrates in tech, increasing both upside potential and drawdown risk. Leveraged ETFs decay daily, and strict stop discipline is crucial to manage significant potential losses.

plan: Significantly increase income ETF (QQQI) to 40% for monthly distributions.
Reduce broad index (SPY) to 20%.
Exit all growth-oriented and leveraged positions (QQQ, SMH, CRWD, METU, SOXL, SPAL).
This shifts the portfolio entirely towards income generation.
Focus is on capital preservation and reliable monthly income.
Expect low growth but very low volatility.
income.read: This income-focused plan prioritizes stable monthly distributions, targeting ~1% per month. It minimizes risk by exiting growth and leveraged positions, focusing on income ETFs. While distributions are prioritized, NAV can still decline in market downturns.
